relations: Disc descends into base, narrowing the gap and compressing the pale-yellow and white residue ring.
Compression drives residue through perforations, extruding pink, white, and yellow strands that lengthen upward.
Extruded strands curve and droop outward, forming a fanning cluster that climbs taller above the disc.
Widening framing reveals a hazard-striped plunger section, the table edge, and a red barrel at left.
caption: A vertical polished-steel plunger ends in a thick perforated disc seated inside a wider cylindrical base, set against green metal cabinets. A ring of pale-yellow and white crushed material fills the gap between the disc and the base. The disc presses downward, compressing this residue as the gap narrows. Thin pink, white, and yellow strands poke out through the disc's perforations. These strands lengthen continuously, curving and drooping outward into a fanning cluster that rises above the disc. The framing widens to reveal a yellow-and-black hazard-striped section of the plunger, the table edge, and a red barrel at left. The extruded noodle-like strands keep growing into a dense, tangled mass. Throughout, the yellow crushed residue at the rim stays roughly constant while the strand cluster climbs taller.
